reasons.text: No duplicate claims share a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account, so no flag is needed.
The label photo is legible and shows the recalled model LXT-CL-1.0, confirming the model.
The date code 0722 is within the recalled range 0722 to 1223.
Purchase at Amazon, a listed retailer, on 2023-11-13, which is inside the sale window; no receipt is required.
The destruction photo shows the device with the plug cut off, as the remedy requires, and it is not a repeat of the label photo.
The remedy is repair or replacement with no refund requested, so the value threshold review does not apply.
